hunks.baseline: Even as his father and the people of the Sakju Branch who had been like family to him died one after another, there was only one thing a fourteen-year-old boy could do: run.
hunks.sol: Even as his father and the people of the Sakju Branch—people who had been like family to him—died one after another, there was only one thing a fourteen-year-old boy could do.
Run.

hunks.baseline: His little sister whimpered in his arms. The boy, Socheon, blew warm breath onto her hands, which had gone stiff with cold.
hunks.sol: His little sister whimpered in his arms. The boy, Socheon, blew warm breath over her hands, stiff with cold.

hunks.baseline: “We’re almost there, so just hold on a little longer. Okay?”

hunks.baseline: “She visited yesterday, too.”
hunks.sol: “She came yesterday, too.”

hunks.baseline: Socheon swallowed the words that followed.
hunks.sol: Socheon swallowed the rest of the sentence.

hunks.baseline: His mother had appeared in his dream the night before, exactly as she had three days earlier. She had spent a long time stroking and gazing at Soyul, who had fallen asleep from exhaustion, before speaking.
hunks.sol: His mother had appeared in his dream the night before, exactly as she had three days earlier. She had spent a long time stroking the exhausted Soyul’s hair and gazing down at her before speaking.

hunks.baseline: Her voice still rang in his ears, and the sight of her back as she led the others away still shimmered before his eyes.
hunks.sol: Her voice still rang in his ears, and the sight of her back as she led the others away still hovered before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: It was then, as he struggled to suppress his ominous feelings, that he heard something.
hunks.sol: He was struggling to suppress the ominous thought when—

hunks.baseline: The sequence of movements came naturally: pulling his little sister close while drawing the dagger from inside his clothes.
hunks.sol: The motion came naturally. He pulled his little sister close and drew the dagger concealed inside his clothes.

hunks.baseline: After the night when his home had burned and he had witnessed countless deaths, the cheerful boy had gained the eyes of a wild beast.
hunks.sol: After the night his home had burned and he had witnessed countless deaths, the once-cheerful boy had acquired the eyes of a wild beast.

hunks.baseline: The dagger slowly lowered when a face suddenly appeared from the darkness.
hunks.sol: The dagger slowly lowered as a face emerged from the darkness.

hunks.baseline: The man called Uncle Gong was a middle-aged man with a weary face. He had been an old friend of Socheon’s father, the Branch Leader of the Sakju Branch, and was now the young siblings’ guide and protector.
hunks.sol: Uncle Gong was a weary-looking middle-aged man. An old friend of Socheon’s father, the Branch Leader of the Sakju Branch, he was now the young siblings’ guide and protector.

hunks.baseline: “I was worried because you hadn’t returned for more than half a shichen.[^1]”
hunks.sol: “I was worried. You were gone for more than half a shichen.[^1]”

hunks.baseline: “I should have been more careful. We have a tail.”
hunks.sol: “I had to be careful. We’ve picked up a tail.”

hunks.baseline: Socheon stood without hesitation. Uncle Gong hoisted the bewildered Soyul onto his back and led the way through the brush.
hunks.sol: Socheon rose without hesitation. Uncle Gong hoisted the bewildered Soyul onto his back and led the way through the brush.

hunks.baseline: “Honju. No matter how cruel those bastards are, they won’t pursue us that far.”
hunks.sol: “Honju. No matter how vicious those bastards are, they won’t pursue us that far.”

hunks.baseline: *Will they really not chase us that far?*
hunks.sol: *Is that really true?*

hunks.baseline: The Sakju Branch had already fallen. The building had burned, and everyone was dead. He did not know who the attackers were, but their purpose was clear.
hunks.sol: The Sakju Branch had already fallen. The buildings had burned, and everyone was dead. He did not know who the attackers were, but their purpose was clear.

hunks.baseline: *Massacre.*
hunks.sol: *Extermination.*

hunks.baseline: He blew the word away with his breath and started walking again.
hunks.sol: He breathed the word into the cold air and started walking again.

hunks.baseline: How long had they walked?
hunks.sol: How long had they been walking?

hunks.baseline: The white snow, which had been drifting down like sleet, had risen to their calves when—
hunks.sol: The white snow that had fluttered down like sleet was already up to their calves when—

hunks.baseline: Uncle Gong stopped walking. Socheon held his breath as well. The only sounds were the howling wind and the clatter of bare branches striking one another.
hunks.sol: Uncle Gong stopped. Socheon held his breath.
The howling wind. Bare branches clattering against one another…
Nothing else.

hunks.baseline: But Socheon knew instinctively.
hunks.sol: Yet Socheon knew instinctively.

hunks.baseline: Uncle Gong answered with a rigid expression.
hunks.sol: Uncle Gong’s face went rigid.

hunks.baseline: “At least ten. They’ll catch up soon.”
hunks.sol: “At least ten of them. They’ll catch up soon.”

hunks.baseline: The situation was bleak. Yet strangely, Socheon’s heart settled into a calm stillness.
hunks.sol: The situation was hopeless. Yet strangely, Socheon’s heart settled into a deep calm.

hunks.baseline: “It was my fault. I should have hurried before the snow began… I curse the heavens.”
hunks.sol: “This is my fault. I should have hurried before the snow began… I curse the heavens.”

hunks.baseline: Socheon drew the dagger from inside his clothes. It had been handed down to him by his father a year ago—the only trace his father had left behind.
hunks.sol: Socheon drew the dagger from inside his clothes. His father had given it to him a year ago. It was the only thing he had left of him.

hunks.baseline: That was all Uncle Gong could say. They summoned what little strength they had left and started moving again.
hunks.sol: That was all Uncle Gong could say. They drew on what little strength they had left and set off again.

hunks.baseline: But their stamina, pushed to its limit by days and nights of nonstop flight, dragged at their feet. Their steps grew slower, and their breathing became labored.
hunks.sol: But days and nights of constant flight had pushed their bodies to the limit. Their steps grew slower. Their breathing became ragged.

hunks.sol: “There they are!”

hunks.baseline: “We’re almost on them!”
hunks.sol: “We’ve almost caught them!”

hunks.baseline: Now Socheon could hear them, too. The pursuers’ voices and their torchlight were drawing closer.
hunks.sol: Now Socheon could hear them, too. The pursuers’ voices and the glow of their torches were drawing closer.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, Uncle Gong handed the soundly sleeping Soyul to Socheon.
hunks.sol: Uncle Gong handed the sleeping Soyul to Socheon.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll bring up the rear.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll follow behind you.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t worry. This Gong Yacheong isn’t such an easy man to take down.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t worry. I, Gong Yacheong, am not so easily dealt with.”

hunks.baseline: “But how can you…”
hunks.sol: “But how can I—”

hunks.baseline: Socheon left Gong Yacheong behind and started up the mountain again. His stamina was at its limit, but he did not stop.
hunks.sol: Leaving Gong Yacheong behind, Socheon started up the mountain again. His body had reached its limit, but he did not stop.

hunks.sol: By the time he reached a hill on the snow-covered mountain, the clash of weapons and someone’s scream rang out behind him.

hunks.baseline: Socheon gritted his teeth. He wanted to draw his dagger and leap down there immediately. But…
hunks.sol: Socheon gritted his teeth. He wanted to draw his dagger and throw himself down the slope that very instant.
But…

hunks.baseline: He had repeated those words hundreds, thousands of times over the past five days. He had sworn that he would survive, protect the little sister in his arms, and take revenge on the murderers.
hunks.sol: He had repeated those words hundreds, thousands of times over the past five days. He had sworn to survive, protect the little sister in his arms, and take revenge on the murderers.

hunks.baseline: From the hilltop, Socheon stared at the flickering torches with eyes that seemed to pour fire.
hunks.sol: From the hilltop, Socheon stared at the flickering torches with fire blazing in his eyes.
Then he turned and climbed over the hill.

hunks.baseline: Then he turned his back and climbed the hill. The next moment, his body shook as if struck by lightning.
hunks.sol: The next moment, his body shook as if struck by lightning.

hunks.baseline: Ten men in navy martial uniforms were looking at Socheon from the wide clearing atop the hill.
hunks.sol: Ten men in navy martial uniforms stood in the broad clearing atop the hill, staring at him.

hunks.sol: A single character had been embroidered prominently across each man’s chest in silk thread.
陳.
Jin.

hunks.baseline: A sound carried faintly over the howling wind. When I raised my internal energy, the sound grew clearer.
hunks.sol: A sound carried faintly through the howling wind. When I drew up my internal energy, it became clearer.

hunks.baseline: *A human voice?*
hunks.sol: *Voices?*

hunks.baseline: There had to be more than ten people. They were close enough that I wondered how I had failed to notice them until now.
hunks.sol: There had to be more than ten people. They were so close, I couldn’t believe I had only just noticed them.

hunks.baseline: All right. I’d made up my mind.
hunks.sol: All right. Decision made.

hunks.baseline: The squad members, who had been preparing for training with their weapons in hand, stared at me, baffled.
hunks.sol: The squad members had been standing ready with their weapons, but now they stared at me in confusion.

hunks.baseline: Damn it. There really was one.
hunks.sol: Damn it. There really was.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know. Is he the owner of this cabin?”
hunks.sol: “No idea. Does he own this cabin?”

hunks.baseline: *Please let that be the case.*
hunks.sol: *Please let that be it.*

hunks.baseline: But why did I find it so hard to believe that the people following him were members of one happy, extended family?
hunks.sol: But why did I find it so hard to believe that the men following him were members of one big, happy family?

hunks.baseline: As someone pointed out, the boy was crying. He was running while sobbing his heart out.
hunks.sol: As someone had pointed out, the boy was crying. Sobbing his heart out as he ran.

hunks.baseline: The problem was where he was headed.
hunks.sol: The problem was the direction he was running in.

hunks.baseline: Suspicious gazes turned toward me. I had already retreated a good distance.
hunks.sol: Suspicious gazes turned toward me. I had already backed well away from them.

hunks.baseline: We looked at them. They looked at us.
hunks.sol: We stared at them. They stared at us.

hunks.baseline: *I knew it. I knew this was how it would turn out.*
hunks.sol: *I knew it. I knew this was going to happen.*

hunks.baseline: But regret was useless now. What could I do about my cursed luck?
hunks.sol: But it was too late for regrets. What could I do about my shitty luck?

hunks.baseline: I let out a deep sigh and shouted.
hunks.sol: I heaved a deep sigh and shouted.

hunks.baseline: “Attack formation. Form up!”
hunks.sol: “Attack formation! Form up!”
Clack-clack-clack.

hunks.baseline: Clack-clack-clack. Caught off guard, the squad members nevertheless moved as they had been taught. By the time they had formed up, the enemy had realized who we were and started shouting.
hunks.sol: Despite being caught off guard, the squad members moved as they had been taught. By the time they finished forming up, the enemy had realized who we were.

hunks.baseline: “There aren’t many of them. Wipe them out!”
hunks.sol: “There aren’t many of them! Wipe them out!”

hunks.baseline: Those two facts hit me right in the chest.
hunks.sol: They had picked out the facts with painful precision.

hunks.baseline: I hadn’t even finished teaching them. Their martial arts were weak, they had no real combat experience, and they were complete rookies.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t even finished teaching these guys. Their martial arts were weak, they had no real combat experience, and they were complete rookies…

hunks.baseline: *If things go bad, should I bolt by myself?*
hunks.sol: *If this goes bad, should I run for it by myself?*

hunks.baseline: Feeling utterly hopeless, I used Qi Sense. Blue waves of qi, visible only to me, swept over the enemies charging forward with shrieks.
hunks.sol: With a growing sense of dread, I used Qi Sense. Blue waves of qi, visible only to me, swept over the enemies charging toward us with wild shrieks.

hunks.baseline: The reconnaissance squad members turned deathly pale.
hunks.sol: The reconnaissance squad members shouted, their faces deathly pale.
Thirty meters. Twenty…

hunks.baseline: As I watched the enemies rush toward us at incredible speed—thirty meters, twenty meters—I opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I watched the enemy close in at terrifying speed and opened my mouth.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t worry. The enemy is nothing but simple EXP… I mean, a rabble. But!”
hunks.sol: “Don’t worry. The enemy is nothing but EXP… I mean, a rabble. But!”

hunks.baseline: *Don’t get the last hit.*
hunks.sol: *Don’t take the last hit.*

hunks.baseline: “Defensive formation. Form up!”
hunks.sol: “Defensive formation! Form up!”

hunks.baseline: Yes. All the EXP was mine.
hunks.sol: Yep. All the EXP was mine.

hunks.baseline: “The squad leader went to commit suicide!”
hunks.sol: “The Squad Leader’s trying to kill himself!”

hunks.baseline: I ignored the reconnaissance squad members’ screams and charged toward the enemies.
hunks.sol: Leaving the reconnaissance squad members’ screams behind, I charged straight at the enemy.

hunks.baseline: Internal energy surged from my dantian and spread through my limbs and bones.
hunks.sol: Internal energy surged from my dantian and raced through every part of my body.

hunks.baseline: The enemy at the front grinned, baring yellow teeth.
hunks.sol: The man at the front grinned, baring yellow teeth.

hunks.baseline: The man clutched his throat and collapsed. As I passed him, the voice I had been waiting for rang out.
hunks.sol: He clutched his throat and collapsed. As I swept past him, the voice I had been waiting for rang out.

hunks.baseline: The enemies were a spectacle in their own way. Facial scars were standard equipment, and their poor hygiene produced a stench that stabbed at my nose.
hunks.sol: The enemy was a magnificent sight. Facial scars came standard, and their hygiene was so atrocious that the stench stabbed at my nose.

hunks.baseline: I felt like I was in a flower garden.
hunks.sol: I felt like I was standing in a flower garden.

hunks.baseline: Twenty flowers filled with the sweet honey of EXP.
hunks.sol: Twenty flowers, each brimming with the sweet honey of EXP.

hunks.baseline: I charged into them with a blissful expression and sucked out the honey.
hunks.sol: Beaming with happiness, I charged into the garden and sucked them dry.
